note: Usage (marginal) rates on the plan each provider was tested on: price per browser-hour and per GB of the provider's own proxy. Monthly fees, included allowances, minute rounding and CAPTCHA fees are left out, so the cost per page compares usage, not a bill.

floppydata.note: Browser sessions are free; rotating residential proxy $1.00/GB.

gologin.note: $0.09 per extra hour on Professional (50 h included); residential $1/GB after 2 GB.

browserbase.note: $20/mo with 100 h and 1 GB, then $0.12/h and $12/GB.

kernel.note: Headful rate $0.0001333336/s (headless $0.06/h); usage rates include proxy usage. Assumes headful, Kernel's default.

anchor.note: Docs: $0.05/h, Anchor Proxy $8/GB. The pricing page calculator shows $0.09/h plus $0.01 per browser start; docs taken.

browserless.note: Overage $0.0020/unit; 1 unit per 30 s of browser (120/h); residential 6 units/MB. CAPTCHA 10 units per solve, not counted.

lightpanda.note: Builder overage $0.08/h. Price of its shared datacenter proxy not published: proxy traffic is not counted.
